waitSpec.description: Specifies various parameters for waitFor* actions.

restartAllServers.description:
Set to true to restart all servers belongs
to the cluster/env/app that start/terminate this CloudService
Example: PG and Cassandra respect this to restart all servers
in order to use the new DataStore config when switching to new DB

configTemplateBindings.description:
Bindings used to configure the CloudResource templates used by the service orchestrator.
Key: template key
Value: binding value
Example: Jupyter passes a userAuthToken binding

resourceProfile.description: Name of the {@link ResourceProfile} to use. Contains configurations such as memory and cpu usage.

waitForReady.description: Decision to wait for service to be fully operational.

notManaged.description: Set to true to use the managed service
